name: Jenzo
description: A young mechanic of Far Corner whose hand the Mukotai nailed to the gate and who builds disruptors with a prosthetic.

timeline.summary: The Mukotai threaten Far Corner after their scout was killed by roots, nailing Jenzo's hand to the gate and giving a week's deadline.
timeline.quote: The Mukotai had signified their intent to retaliate with a hand nailed to the gate of Far Corner.

timeline.summary: Chishiro trains the townsfolk and plans a trap using disruptors to drive the Mukotai toward Jukai.
timeline.quote: the plan was to lure the Mukotai down to the Jukai end of Far Corner's main street.

timeline.summary: The disruptors trigger and the fight turns chaotic, with a Mukotai mech crushing a disruptor.
timeline.quote: A minuscule squeeze; the disruptor shattered.

timeline.summary: Chishiro has Ayari and Jenzo evacuate the townsfolk, then confronts Kaima over killing those who love him.
timeline.quote: Chishiro advanced toward his old friend—blade in hand and root in chest.
